assertions.subject: Mastocytosis
assertions.quote: Mastocytosis is characterized by mast cell infiltration of various organs, including the skin

assertions.subject: Urticaria pigmentosa
assertions.quote: Urticaria pigmentosa appears as hyperpigmented, red-brown macules, which may coalesce

assertions.subject: Muckle-Wells syndrome
assertions.quote: Muckle-Wells syndrome is an autosomal dominant disorder characterized by episodic urticaria presenting in infancy

assertions.subject: Schnitzler syndrome
assertions.quote: Schnitzler syndrome is characterized by chronic urticaria, macroglobulinemia, bone pain, anemia, fever, fatigue, and weight loss

assertions.subject: Urticarial vasculitis
assertions.quote: Urticarial vasculitis is a small vessel vasculitis with histologic features of aleukocytoclastic response

assertions.subject: Urticarial vasculitis
assertions.quote: The main distinguishing feature is that the lesions last longer than 24 hours, may be tender, and leave behind skin pigmentation
